speaker: DAUGHTER
text: I am very cold, and all the stars are out too,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: The little stars and all, that look like aglets.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: The sun has seen my folly.—Palamon!

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Alas, no; he’s in heaven. Where am I now?

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Yonder’s the sea, and there’s a ship. How ’t tumbles!

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And there’s a rock lies watching under water.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Now, now, it beats upon it; now, now, now,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: There’s a leak sprung, a sound one! How they cry!

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Open her before the wind; you’ll lose all else.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Up with a course or two, and tack about, boys!

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Good night, good night; you’re gone. I am very

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: hungry.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Would I could find a fine frog; he would tell me

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: News from all parts o’ th’ world; then would I make

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: A carrack of a cockleshell, and sail

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: By east and northeast to the king of pygmies,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: For he tells fortunes rarely. Now my father,ACT 3. SC. 5

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Twenty to one, is trussed up in a trice

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Tomorrow morning. I’ll say never a word.(Sing.)

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: For I’ll cut my green coat a foot above my knee,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And I’ll clip my yellow locks an inch below mine

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: eye.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Hey nonny, nonny, nonny.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: He’s buy me a white cut, forth for to ride,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: And I’ll go seek him through the world that is so

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: wide.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: Hey nonny, nonny, nonny.

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: O, for a prick now, like a nightingale,

speaker: DAUGHTER
text: To put my breast against. I shall sleep like a top else.
